name: romm
description: Full control of a RomM ROM-library server (5.x) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server that authenticates with a RomM API key and exposes both a generic passthrough reaching every one of the server's ~189 REST operations (self-discovered from its live OpenAPI spec) plus ~70 curated tools for status, platforms, ROM search & metadata editing, ROM manuals/soundtracks/patches, screenshots, collections (manual/smart/virtual), users & fine-grained permission groups & API keys, saves/states/firmware, tasks, config, device management & pairing approval, sync sessions, netplay rooms, activity & play sessions, game music, client feeds, gamelist/Pegasus exports, chunked ROM upload/download — and a pollable Socket.IO scan trigger (the one job RomM does not expose over REST). Includes a control skill and slash-command workflows. Tested against RomM 5.0.0.
